external-torque.def: A torque on a system from an object outside it. Only the net external torque can change a system’s total angular momentum.

conservation-angular-momentum.def: The total angular momentum of a system stays constant when the net external torque on it is zero. The parts can trade angular momentum, but the total does not change.

shape-change.def: When a system changes shape with no net external torque (a skater pulling in her arms), its rotational inertia changes and its angular velocity changes the opposite way so that L = Iω stays the same.
